name: Perplexity
bestFor: Fast, cited market and competitor research to kick off product discovery
description: An AI answer engine that searches the live web and returns cited, source-backed answers — the fastest way to get up to speed on a market, competitor, or technology before writing a single requirement.

freeTier.limits: Free tier with limited daily Pro searches

paidTier.notes: Pro is $20/mo. Enterprise Pro is $40/seat/month and Enterprise Max is $325/seat/month, with SCIM, audit logs, and configurable data retention.

name: Notion AI
bestFor: Turning research and meeting notes into PRDs, specs, and a searchable knowledge base
description: AI built directly into Notion's docs and databases — drafting PRDs, summarizing meetings, auto-filling databases, and (on Business+) running multi-step tasks via Notion Agent.

freeTier.limits: Free workspace plan includes a limited AI trial

paidTier.notes: Plus is $10/member/month (AI still trial-limited). Business at $20/member/month unlocks full Notion Agent, AI meeting notes, and enterprise search. Enterprise is custom.

name: Miro AI
bestFor: AI-assisted brainstorming, diagramming, and turning sticky notes into structured plans
description: AI features layered onto Miro's collaborative whiteboard — diagram generation, note clustering and synthesis, and interactive prototyping for early-stage product exploration.

paidTier.notes: Starter is $8/member/month (billed yearly) with 25 AI credits/member/month; Business is $20/member/month with 50 credits; Enterprise is custom, starting at 2,500 pooled credits/month.

name: v0 by Vercel
bestFor: Turning a product idea into a clickable, real-code UI prototype in minutes
description: Vercel's AI UI generator that produces working React/Next.js components and full screens from a text prompt or screenshot — a fast bridge from idea to reviewable prototype.

paidTier.notes: Plus is $30/mo ($30 of monthly credits/user); Business is $100/user/month; Enterprise is custom with training opt-out and SAML SSO.

name: Productboard
bestFor: Turning scattered customer feedback into a prioritized, AI-assisted roadmap
description: A product management platform whose Spark AI agent clusters customer feedback, surfaces themes, drafts specs, and helps prioritize what to build next.

freeTier.limits: Free plan: 50 AI credits/month, unlimited roadmaps, 500 feedback notes, 25 contributors

paidTier.notes: Plus is $19/maker/month (annual), 250 AI credits/maker; Business $59/maker/month, 500 credits; Enterprise custom, 800 credits/maker.

name: Dovetail
bestFor: AI-assisted synthesis of user interviews, call transcripts, and survey data into themes
description: A research repository and analysis tool that uses AI to summarize interviews, tag transcripts, cluster insights, and surface recurring themes across all of a team's user research.

freeTier.limits: 1 channel, 1 project, basic AI summaries and opportunity tracking, no card required

paidTier.notes: No published mid-tier price — Dovetail moves directly from Free to a custom-quoted Enterprise plan with unlimited projects, AI dashboards, and semantic search.
